Characters

Melusine - The Mother

I made the mother an ageless witch to evoke a dreamlike world and my childhood belief that my mother could do anything. Giving life, nurturing hopes, and guiding a child feel like magic. I wish she could stay forever young, her wondrous heart unchanged.

Her power to swap places with Ilian embodies a mother’s wish to bear her child’s dangers and hardships.

Raised under Melusine’s protection, Ilian seeks independence with curiosity and pride. She loves her mother but struggles to voice her wishes, learning to trust her while finding the courage to fly alone.

Her candlelight reveals and reshapes nearby roads, reflecting her growth as she learns to recognize and choose her own path.
